description:
Bring your saved Folderly AI campaign context into your assistant. Find a campaign, open its brief and current draft, and use the audience, voice, offer, and approved proof you supplied to prepare your next email.

Review an email you wrote or drafted with your assistant, then save useful work as an editable campaign draft when you request it. You can also check your account allowance and explicitly ask Folderly AI to generate one email after reviewing its operation cost. Generation uses your existing account entitlement and allowance; reviewing and saving do not consume Folderly generation credits.

You choose which campaign to open and when to save. Updates replace the current draft, clear its approval, and retain up to ten saved versions; a further save can permanently remove the oldest version. The connector does not send, schedule, or approve emails. Content review provides writing findings; it does not verify facts, predict replies, or measure inbox placement.

A Folderly AI account and an authorized connection are required. Selected campaign content and supplied email copy are shared with the connected assistant to perform your requested task. Folderly generation is available only where included in your account’s existing API entitlement.

defaultPrompt: Show my saved campaign summaries so I can choose one to work on.
Review my email subject and body. Ask me to paste the draft first.
Check my allowance and show the cost of generating one email before you generate.
